outOfScope: Global scheduler, role registry or organization workflow graph.
Exactly-once event transport or transactional outbox as a correctness prerequisite.
Deployment, AcceptanceSnapshot or Product QA semantics.
Execution-policy or strategy selection inside the activation boundary.
constraints: Event or queue delivery is not lifecycle, claim or execution authority.
Activation is not strategy selection and is not obligation creation.
Queue, cursor and local backoff state are disposable and reconstructable from canonical work state.
A stale queued hint cannot resurrect invalidated work.
Frontend and Backend independence is governed by exact semantic dependencies, not global development stages.
A durable runtime such as Restate may host activation mechanics but cannot become organizational source of truth or hidden scheduler.
invariants: one domain outage must not block unrelated domain work
queued stale hints cannot resurrect invalidated work
architectureDecisions: DOMAIN_ACTIVATION is level-triggered per owning domain: scans/hints only discover exact work; canonical OrganizationWork + currentness are reread before claim.
Activation key is {projectId,workId,owningDomain}; trigger payload cannot grant principal, claim, strategy, runtime, obligation or publication authority.
Canonical scans are recovery truth; queue/cursor/backoff state is disposable. Duplicate hints converge through existing claim/release and ExecutionAttempt currentness.
BB-052 is a hard WORKER dependency: it must preserve requiredArtifactRefs and expose exact obligation-head currentness or BB-053 returns to RESEARCH_SA.
DomainExecutionInput is immutable content-addressed execution data in requiredArtifactRefs; adapters require exactly one ref matching WorkContract owningDomain/workloadType.
DomainExecutionController resolves current policy/strategy and passes the exact WorkContract to its prebound runtime adapter; activation never selects HOW.
BACKEND and FRONTEND use separate principals, hosts, controllers and adapters. Shared stores provide CAS/currentness only, never stage ordering or a cross-domain lock.
A post-release reread of the same obligationSubjectKey+revision gates execution; drift fences the exact claim and creates no execution attempt.
Parallel proof requires both FE/BE dispatches entered before either completes; host-local failure cannot cancel the sibling; selective invalidation affects only the exact obligation subject.
implementationSlices: D1 — DomainExecutionInput bridge [AC-5, AC-6]: add domain-execution-input.js with immutable schema {kind:'DOMAIN_EXECUTION_INPUT',version:1,owningDomain,workloadType,repository:{ref,revision},requiredFiles[],constraints[]} and content-addressed ref domain-execution-input:sha256:<digest>. A WorkContract is executable only when requiredArtifactRefs contains exactly one such ref whose domain/workload matches the contract. Add registry put/resolve over the existing immutable artifact store.

D2 — Generic execution adapter seam [AC-2, AC-3, AC-4, INV-4, INV-5]: extend DomainExecutionController runtimeAdapter calls from {binding,input,runtimeInvocationKey} to {binding,contract,input,runtimeInvocationKey}; contract is the exact immutable OrganizationWorkContract already resolved from the released claim. Existing policy/strategy resolution and attempt binding stay authoritative. Activation never supplies strategy/runtime/domain input.

D3 — Activation + domain/admission/currentness fence [AC-1, AC-2, AC-3, AC-4, AC-8, INV-1, INV-3, INV-4, INV-5, INV-8]: domain-activation-source.scan({owningDomain}) wraps listEligible. reconcile(key={projectId,workId,owningDomain}) first resolves the exact WorkContract and requires key.owningDomain === host.owningDomain === contract.owningDomain; mismatch returns REJECTED/NOOP before any claimController call. Trigger payload fields are never used as principal/strategy/obligation authority. For a valid domain, capture exact {obligationSubjectKey,revision,status}; claim/release canonically; reread the same head immediately before execute. Non-ACTIVE or revision drift invalidates/fences that exact claim, returns NOOP, leaves no execution attempt and dispatch count zero. Only unchanged currentness may call execute({itemId,claimGeneration,receiptRef}).

D4 — Backend adapter [AC-5, AC-6]: backend-execution-strategy resolves the single DomainExecutionInput from contract.requiredArtifactRefs, validates BACKEND/workload match, builds BackendObjective {id:contract.boardItemId,task:contract.summary,repository:input.repository,requiredFiles:input.requiredFiles,constraints:input.constraints}, then delegates to existing prepare/run/recover Backend application primitives. It emits DomainExecutionController runtime-result shape and never invokes runBackendThenQaObjective.

D5 — Frontend domain [AC-5, AC-6, INV-6, INV-7]: frontend-contracts defines FrontendObjective/WorkOrder/Context/WorkResult/Completion with the same id/task/repository/requiredFiles/constraints input shape and FE-specific evidence claims; frontend-worker/application provide execute/recover; frontend-execution-strategy performs the same deterministic WorkContract+DomainExecutionInput mapping for FRONTEND only.

D6 — Independent domain hosts + runtime composition [AC-5, AC-6, AC-7, INV-2, INV-3, INV-6, INV-7]: domain-activation-host.js owns exactly one domain/principal/controller plus private loop/timer/error state. start() immediately scans canonical listEligible(domain); scanOnce() uses Promise.allSettled(reconcile(exactKey)); periodic scan/notify state is disposable latency state, never work truth or ordering authority. BACKEND and FRONTEND hosts start independently with separate DomainExecutionController/runtimeAdapter. No ranking, nextRole/nextDomain/stage API, shared mutex or other-domain completion dependency exists.

D7 — Acceptance + invariant proofs [AC-1..AC-8, INV-1..INV-8]: domain-activation tests prove trigger fields cannot authorize and wrong-domain mismatch causes zero claim/attempt/dispatch; recovery tests delete hint state and prove startup scan rediscovery plus duplicate convergence; race test pauses after release, supersedes exact obligation, then proves claim fence + zero attempt/dispatch; FE/BE fixture requires both dispatchStarted before either completion and distinct contract/policy/strategy/attempt/invocation identities; outage fixture rejects one adapter while sibling reaches TERMINAL via host-local allSettled containment; selective invalidation makes stale hint for exact invalidated obligation NOOP while unrelated obligation remains listEligible and executes.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Persisted actionable work is rediscovered and processed after controller restart even when its original notification was lost.
evidenceRequired: Fresh host with no hint/timer state immediately scans listEligible(domain) and enters claim/execution without an event.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Concurrent duplicate hints for one work item converge to one current claim/execution path.
evidenceRequired: Concurrent notify+scan for one exact key converge to one current claim/attempt; duplicate becomes NOOP/replay.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A wrong-domain activation attempt cannot claim or execute the work.
evidenceRequired: Construct a host bound to BACKEND and present an exact work key/WorkContract owned by FRONTEND (and the converse).

reconcile must compare key.owningDomain, host.owningDomain and contract.owningDomain before claim; mismatch returns REJECTED/NOOP with claimController calls=0, executionAttemptStore empty and runtime dispatch=0.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Obligation supersession between activation pre-check and execution entry prevents execution through the post-release currentness recheck.
evidenceRequired: Barrier pauses reconcile after RELEASED claim but before execution entry. Record the exact pre-check {obligationSubjectKey, revision, ACTIVE}.

Supersede that exact obligation head while paused; post-release reread of the same subject must detect revision/status drift, invoke canonical claim invalidation/fencing, return NOOP, and leave both executionAttemptStore and runtime dispatch count at zero.
A sibling work item bound to a different obligationSubjectKey remains eligible/executable in the same fixture.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Frontend and Backend work can progress concurrently and independently under their own domain execution strategies.
evidenceRequired: Persist unrelated BACKEND and FRONTEND WorkContracts with no semantic dependency edge, distinct DomainExecutionInputs and distinct ACTIVE execution-policy/strategy bindings.
Start both DomainActivationHosts without awaiting one before the other. Each adapter raises dispatchStarted and waits on an independent deferred barrier.

Before releasing either barrier assert both dispatchStarted signals plus distinct workContractRef, executionPolicyRef, executionStrategyRef, executionAttemptId and runtimeInvocationKey; sequential start after the other domain completes does not satisfy AC-5.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: An outage in one domain leaves unrelated work in another domain actionable and able to progress.
evidenceRequired: After both independent domain dispatches have started, reject one runtime adapter. The failing host records only local failure/recovery state; its scan uses Promise.allSettled and cannot reject/cancel the sibling host.
Release the unrelated domain barrier and assert that domain reaches its own TERMINAL/current completion path without reading the failed domain claim, attempt, session, stage or completion state.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Removing a manual next-role dispatcher does not stop progress for persisted actionable work.
evidenceRequired: No nextRole/nextDomain/stage API exists; with no event, startup/periodic domain scans still discover and reconcile persisted work.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Partial upstream invalidation suppresses only affected activation subjects while unrelated domain work remains actionable.
evidenceRequired: Create two actionable work items with different obligationSubjectKey values. Invalidate/supersede exactly one subject and preserve the other ACTIVE.
A stale notify/reconcile for the invalidated subject must become NOOP/fenced with no new execution attempt or dispatch.
The next canonical scan still returns the unrelated subject; it may claim, dispatch and complete. No organization-wide/stage reset is invoked.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Wake-up event or hint data cannot grant principal, claim, execution, strategy, obligation or publication authority.
evidenceRequired: Inject spoofed principal/strategy/runtime fields in notify payload; reconcile derives authority only from configured host + canonical stores and the spoofed fields change no claim/attempt/publication.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Queue, cursor, timer and hint state are disposable latency state and never canonical work truth.
evidenceRequired: Delete all host hint/cursor/timer state, restart, and prove immediate canonical domain scan rediscovers the same actionable work.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Activation operates on exact work identities and cannot rank, schedule or choose a next role/domain.
evidenceRequired: Public activation/host APIs expose exact-key reconcile + domain scan only; no priority/ranking/nextRole/nextDomain/stage transition path exists.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Activation cannot select or override ExecutionPolicy, ExecutionStrategyDescriptor or runtime adapter.
evidenceRequired: Activation execution entry contains only itemId+claimGeneration+receiptRef; DomainExecutionController current policy/strategy and prebound adapter remain mandatory.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Activation cannot create, mutate or make current a CrossDomainObligation.
evidenceRequired: No obligation write API is injected into activation; forged obligation data in a hint cannot change obligation state.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Frontend and Backend have no implicit stage barrier; only explicit semantic work dependencies may block actionability.
evidenceRequired: Unrelated FE/BE work has no dependency edge and both enter dispatch before either completes; Backend stage/session/completion is absent from Frontend inputs.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Failure of one owning-domain host cannot cancel, gate or pause unrelated domain progress.
evidenceRequired: One adapter rejects after both hosts start; allSettled/local host error state contains failure and sibling reaches its own terminal completion.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A stale hint cannot resurrect work whose exact obligation/currentness became non-current.
evidenceRequired: After exact obligation invalidation, stale notify produces NOOP with zero claim/attempt/dispatch while unrelated obligation remains executable.

invariantCoverage.invariant: one domain outage must not block unrelated domain work
queued stale hints cannot resurrect invalidated work

negativeVerificationCases: Role/stage activation without exact work key is rejected.
Lost hint state cannot strand canonical work.
Duplicate hints cannot create duplicate current claims/attempts.
Activation cannot select strategy or create obligation.
Post-release recheck must compare the same obligation subject and observed revision.
FE/BE concurrency fails unless both dispatchStarted before either completion.
One host failure cannot cancel sibling progress; Promise.all-style cancellation is rejected.
Stale hint after invalidation cannot execute.
Selective invalidation cannot block an unrelated obligation subject.
